source.text: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥דלוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ יֹֽאמַר־נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: The song of the ascents, of David. If not YHWH who was for us — let say, please, Israel —

en.L: A song of ascents. Of David. If [it had] not [been] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who was for us — let Israel now say —
en.B: A song of ascents. Of David. Let Israel say it now: if {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had not stood with us,
en.R: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem. By David. Let Israel say it: What if {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had not been on our side?

fr.L: Cantique des montées. De David. Si [ce n’avait] pas [été] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui était pour nous — qu’Israël le dise donc —
fr.B: Cantique des montées. De David. Qu’Israël le dise maintenant : si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne s’était pas tenu avec nous,
fr.R: Chant pour la montée vers Jérusalem. De David. Qu’Israël le dise : Que serait-il arrivé si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’avait pas été de notre côté ?

sw.L: Wimbo wa kupanda. Wa Daudi. Kama [isingekuwa] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyekuwa upande wetu — Israeli na aseme sasa —
sw.B: Wimbo wa kupanda. Wa Daudi. Israeli na aseme sasa: kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asingesimama pamoja nasi,
sw.R: Wimbo wa safari ya kupanda kwenda Yerusalemu. Wa Daudi. Israeli na aseme: Ingekuwaje kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asingekuwa upande wetu?

es.L: Cántico de las subidas. De David. Si no [hubiera sido] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien estaba a favor nuestro —que lo diga ahora Israel—,
es.B: Cántico de las subidas. De David. Que lo diga ahora Israel: si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no hubiera estado con nosotros,
es.R: Canto para el viaje de subida a Jerusalén. De David. Que lo diga Israel: ¿Qué habría pasado si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no hubiera estado de nuestro lado?

vi.L: Bài ca cho những lần đi lên. Của Đa-vít. Nếu [không phải] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng đã ở về phía chúng ta, Y-sơ-ra-ên giờ đây hãy nói,
vi.B: Bài ca đi lên. Của Đa-vít. Giờ đây Y-sơ-ra-ên hãy nói: nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không đứng về phía chúng ta,
vi.R: Bài ca cho cuộc hành trình lên Giê-ru-sa-lem. Của Đa-vít. Y-sơ-ra-ên hãy nói lên: Điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không đứng về phía chúng ta?

ko.L: 올라감을 위한 노래. 다윗의 [노래]. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리 편이 되어 계시지 않았더라면 — 이제 이스라엘은 말하여라 —
ko.B: 올라가며 부르는 노래. 다윗의 노래. 이스라엘은 이제 이렇게 말하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리 편에 서 계시지 않았더라면,
ko.R: 예루살렘으로 올라가며 부르는 노래. 다윗의 노래. 이스라엘은 이렇게 말하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리 편이 아니셨다면 어떻게 되었겠는가?

pt.L: Cântico dos degraus. De Davi. Se não [fosse] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que esteve do nosso lado — que Israel diga agora —
pt.B: Cântico das subidas. De Davi. Que Israel diga agora: se {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não tivesse ficado do nosso lado,
pt.R: Canção para a subida a Jerusalém. De Davi. Que Israel diga: E se {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não estivesse do nosso lado?

am.L: የመውጣት መዝሙር። የዳዊት። ከእኛ ጋር የነበረው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ባይሆን ኖሮ፣ እስራኤል አሁን እንዲህ ይበል፦
am.B: የመውጣት መዝሙር። የዳዊት። እስራኤል አሁን እንዲህ ይበል፦ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእኛ ጋር ባይቆም ኖሮ፣
am.R: የመውጣት መዝሙር፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጡ የሚዘመር። ዳዊት የዘመረው። እስራኤል እንዲህ ይበል፦ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከጎናችን ባይሆን ኖሮ ምን ይደርስብን ነበር?

hi.L: चढ़ाई का गीत। दाऊद का। \q यदि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [न होते] जो हमारी ओर थे — \q इस्राएल अब कहे —
hi.B: चढ़ाई का गीत। दाऊद का। \q इस्राएल अब यह कहे: \q यदि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे साथ न खड़े होते,
hi.R: यरूशलेम की ओर जाने की यात्रा का गीत। दाऊद का लिखा हुआ। \q इस्राएल यह कहे: \q अगर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारी तरफ़ न होते, तो क्या होता?

ru.L: Песнь восхождения. Давида. \q Если бы не {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, который был за нас, — \q пусть скажет ныне Израиль, —
ru.B: Песнь восхождения. Давида. \q Пусть Израиль скажет теперь: \q если бы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не стоял за нас,
ru.R: Песня для пути в Иерусалим. Написал Давид. \q Пусть Израиль скажет: \q что, если бы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не был на нашей стороне?

ja.L: 上りの歌。ダビデによる。 \q もし、わたしたちの味方であった方が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}でなかったなら――イスラエルは、さあ、言え――
ja.B: 都に上る歌。ダビデによる。 \q さあ、イスラエルは言え。 \q もし{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしたちと共にいてくださらなかったなら、
ja.R: エルサレムへ上る旅の歌。ダビデによる。 \q イスラエルの人々は、さあ、言おう。 \q もし{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしたちの味方でいてくださらなかったら、どうなっていただろう？

uk.L: Пісня сходжень. Давидів. \q Якби не {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, що був за нас, — \q нехай же скаже Ізраїль, —
uk.B: Пісня сходжень. Давидів. \q Нехай Ізраїль скаже це тепер: \q якби {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не стояв за нас,
uk.R: Пісня для подорожі вгору до Єрусалима. Її склав Давид. \q Нехай Ізраїль скаже: \q Що було б, якби {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не був на нашому боці?

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: As in 120:1, the short title and the first line are counted together as verse 1, so the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a song of ascents: probably a pilgrim song
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one of the fifteen songs probably sung by pilgrims going up to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: of David: linked with David
decisions.reason: Four of the Songs of Ascents (122, 124, 131, 133) add "of David", and one (127) "of Solomon". As elsewhere in the Psalms, "of" may mean the psalm is by him, belongs to a collection named for him, or is written for or about him. Some ancient copies of these titles lack the name.

decisions.choice: if not ... for us: what would have happened
decisions.reason: "If not" (lule) introduces something that did not happen: the LORD was on Israel's side. The sentence is broken off by "let Israel say", begun again in verse 2, and finished with "then" in verses 3-5.

decisions.choice: let Israel say: the people join in
decisions.reason: The leader calls on the whole people to repeat the words, as in 118:2 and 129:1.

decisions.choice: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As in 120:1.

decisions.choice: Let Israel say it now: first
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the call to Israel first so that the record can end with the unfinished sentence; Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" for the people who sing together
decisions.reason: Israel speaks of itself, and all who join the song are included, so Vietnamese uses the inclusive "chúng ta" rather than "chúng tôi", which would leave the hearers out.

decisions.choice: The unreal condition is "-지 않았더라면" (verses 1-2), answered by "그때에 ... -었을 것이다" (verses 3-5)
alternatives: -지 않았다면 with a single sentence for verses 1-5
decisions.reason: Korean marks a condition contrary to fact with "-었더라면" and its outcome with "-었을 것이다"; each verse keeps its own clause, so the long sentence of the Hebrew runs across verses as in the English Literal and Balanced. Readable asks the question, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "if not the LORD who was for us" as "… ባይሆን ኖሮ" (had it not been), the unreal condition that verses 3-5 complete with "… ነበር"
decisions.reason: The psalm looks back on what would have happened (meaning decision m4); Amharic marks a past unreal condition with "-ባይሆን ኖሮ" and its result with "… ነበር".

decisions.choice: "यदि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [न होते]": the sentence left open
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins a condition, breaks off for the call to Israel, and takes it up again in verse 2 (meaning m4, m5). Literal keeps the broken sentence and its order; Balanced puts the call first, as the English does; Readable makes it a question.

decisions.choice: Песнь восхождения (L, B); Песня для пути в Иерусалим (R)
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one form of the title per level through the Songs of Ascents.

decisions.choice: yo'mar-na' Yisra'el "イスラエルは、さあ、言え" (L), "さあ、イスラエルは言え" (B), "イスラエルの人々は、さあ、言おう" (R)
decisions.reason: The same forms as 118:2 ("let Israel say it now"); the people are called to join in (m5). B puts it first, as the English B does.

decisions.choice: lulei … shehayah lanu "もし、わたしたちの味方であった方がDNでなかったなら" (L), "もしDNがわたしたちと共にいてくださらなかったなら" (B), "…味方でいてくださらなかったら、どうなっていただろう？" (R)
decisions.reason: The broken-off condition (m4): L and B leave it open with ―― / 、 as the Hebrew does; R asks what would have happened, as the English R.

source.text: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: If not YHWH who was for us, when rose up against us a man,

en.L: if [it had] not [been] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who was for us when {{gender:people|men}} rose up against us,
en.B: if {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had not stood with us when {{gender:people|men}} rose up against us,
en.R: What if {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had not been on our side when {{gender:people|men}} attacked us?

fr.L: si [ce n’avait] pas [été] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui était pour nous, quand des {{gender:humains|hommes}} se sont levés contre nous,
fr.B: si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne s’était pas tenu avec nous quand des {{gender:humains|hommes}} se sont levés contre nous,
fr.R: Que serait-il arrivé si {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’avait pas été de notre côté quand des {{gender:humains|hommes}} nous ont attaqués ?

sw.L: kama [isingekuwa] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyekuwa upande wetu, watu walipoinuka dhidi yetu,
sw.B: kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asingesimama pamoja nasi watu walipotuinukia,
sw.R: Ingekuwaje kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asingekuwa upande wetu watu walipotushambulia?

es.L: si no [hubiera sido] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien estaba a favor nuestro cuando se alzaron contra nosotros {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}},
es.B: si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no hubiera estado con nosotros cuando {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} se levantaron contra nosotros,
es.R: ¿Qué habría pasado si {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no hubiera estado de nuestro lado cuando {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} nos atacaron?

vi.L: nếu [không phải] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng đã ở về phía chúng ta khi người ta nổi lên chống lại chúng ta,
vi.B: nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không đứng về phía chúng ta khi người ta nổi lên chống lại chúng ta,
vi.R: Điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không đứng về phía chúng ta khi người ta tấn công chúng ta?

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리 편이 되어 계시지 않았더라면, 사람들이 우리를 치러 일어났을 때,
ko.B: 사람들이 우리를 치러 일어났을 때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리 편에 서 계시지 않았더라면,
ko.R: 사람들이 우리를 공격했을 때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리 편이 아니셨다면 어떻게 되었겠는가?

pt.L: se não [fosse] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que esteve do nosso lado, quando {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} se levantaram contra nós,
pt.B: se {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não tivesse ficado do nosso lado quando {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} se levantaram contra nós,
pt.R: E se {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não estivesse do nosso lado quando {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} nos atacaram?

am.L: በእኛ ላይ ሰዎች በተነሡ ጊዜ፣ ከእኛ ጋር የነበረው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ባይሆን ኖሮ፣
am.B: ሰዎች በእኛ ላይ በተነሡ ጊዜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእኛ ጋር ባይቆም ኖሮ፣
am.R: ሰዎች ባጠቁን ጊዜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከጎናችን ባይሆን ኖሮ ምን ይደርስብን ነበር?

hi.L: यदि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [न होते] जो हमारी ओर थे, \q जब {{gender:लोग|मनुष्य}} हमारे विरुद्ध उठे,
hi.B: यदि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे साथ न खड़े होते \q जब {{gender:लोग|मनुष्य}} हमारे विरुद्ध उठे,
hi.R: अगर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उस समय हमारी तरफ़ न होते \q जब {{gender:लोगों|मनुष्यों}} ने हम पर हमला किया, तो क्या होता?

ru.L: если бы не {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, который был за нас, \q когда люди восстали на нас,
ru.B: если бы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не стоял за нас, \q когда люди восстали против нас,
ru.R: Что, если бы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} не был на нашей стороне, \q когда люди напали на нас?

ja.L: もし、わたしたちの味方であった方が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}でなかったなら、 \q 人々がわたしたちに逆らって立ち上がったとき、
ja.B: もし{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしたちと共にいてくださらなかったなら、 \q 人々がわたしたちに襲いかかってきたとき、
ja.R: もし{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がわたしたちの味方でいてくださらなかったら、 \q 人々が攻めて来たとき、どうなっていただろう？

uk.L: якби не {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, що був за нас, \q коли {{gender:люди|мужі}} повстали проти нас,
uk.B: якби {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не стояв за нас, \q коли {{gender:люди|мужі}} повстали проти нас,
uk.R: Що було б, якби {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} не був на нашому боці, \q коли {{gender:люди|мужі}} напали на нас?

decisions.choice: a man: mere humans
decisions.reason: The word ('adam) means human beings. The enemies are only human, set against the LORD who was on Israel's side.

decisions.choice: the opening repeated
decisions.reason: Verse 2 repeats the opening of verse 1 and adds when the danger came; the sentence runs on into verse 3.

decisions.choice: people
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general; the gender setting gives the traditional "men".

decisions.choice: "humains" by default, "hommes" as the gender alternative, on the noun for ʾadam
decisions.reason: ʾAdam means human beings, mere mortals set against God. As the French terms settle, the gender setting goes on the noun: "humains" by default, the traditional "hommes" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "watu" (people) with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The Hebrew adam means human beings, and Swahili "watu" says that plainly. The only other wording, "wanaume", would mean males only and change the sense, so Swahili has no setting here where the English has one.

decisions.choice: a gender setting on "los seres humanos" (L), "las personas" (B, R), with "los hombres" as the other wording
decisions.reason: The Hebrew 'adam means human beings. Spanish has the same choice the English setting offers, so the setting stands here; the plural keeps the verb the same in both wordings.

decisions.choice: "người ta" (people) with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English ("people"/"men")
decisions.reason: The word means mere human beings (see the meaning decision); "người ta" already covers men and women, so Vietnamese has no second form for the setting to give.

decisions.choice: "사람들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "사람들" already includes women and men and is the natural word for the Hebrew "a man" (mere humans, meaning decision); Korean has no second wording to offer for the English span, as in Psalm 139:19.

decisions.choice: {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}}
decisions.reason: 'Adam means human beings (m1); Portuguese has to choose a noun, so the default says "as pessoas" and the gender setting gives the traditional "os homens", as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "a man" (ʾadam, mere humans) as "ሰዎች" with no gender span
alternatives: a span "ሰዎች" / "ወንዶች" like the English one
decisions.reason: "ሰዎች" already means people of either sex, so Amharic has no second wording to offer; the English span has nothing to change here.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:लोग|मनुष्य}}"
decisions.reason: The word (adam) means human beings in general (meaning m1). As the English does, the default says "लोग" and the gender setting gives the traditional "मनुष्य", which in Hindi is itself close to inclusive.

decisions.choice: люди, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span (people / men) for 'adam, human beings in general (m1). Russian люди already covers men and women, and the traditional rendering says the same, so there is no second wording to offer.

decisions.choice: 'adam "人々" at every level, with no gender span (English {{gender:people|men}})
decisions.reason: Japanese 人々 is already inclusive (style guide §7); 'adam stresses mere humans (m1).

source.text: אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּנוּ בַּחֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣ם בָּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: then alive they would have swallowed us, when burned their anger against us,

en.L: then they would have swallowed us alive, when their anger burned against us,
en.B: then they would have devoured us alive in the heat of their anger against us,
en.R: Then they would have eaten us alive, because their anger burned against us.

fr.L: alors ils nous auraient engloutis vivants, quand leur colère s’est enflammée contre nous,
fr.B: alors ils nous auraient dévorés vivants dans le feu de leur colère contre nous,
fr.R: Alors ils nous auraient mangés vivants, parce que leur colère brûlait contre nous.

sw.L: basi wangetumeza tukiwa hai, hasira yao ilipowaka juu yetu,
sw.B: basi wangetumeza wazima katika ukali wa hasira yao dhidi yetu,
sw.R: Wangetumeza tukiwa hai, kwa sababu walitukasirikia mno.

es.L: entonces nos habrían tragado vivos, cuando su ira ardía contra nosotros;
es.B: entonces nos habrían devorado vivos en el calor de su ira contra nosotros;
es.R: Entonces nos habrían comido vivos, porque su enojo ardía contra nosotros.

vi.L: thì chúng đã nuốt sống chúng ta, khi cơn giận của chúng bừng lên chống lại chúng ta,
vi.B: thì chúng đã nuốt sống chúng ta trong cơn giận phừng phừng chống lại chúng ta,
vi.R: Thì chúng đã ăn tươi nuốt sống chúng ta rồi, vì cơn giận của chúng bừng bừng nổi lên chống lại chúng ta.

ko.L: 그때에 그들이 우리를 산 채로 삼켰을 것이다, 그들의 분노가 우리를 향해 타오를 때에.
ko.B: 그들이 우리를 향해 분노를 불태울 때 우리를 산 채로 집어삼켰을 것이고,
ko.R: 그랬다면 그들이 우리를 산 채로 잡아먹었을 것이다. 그들의 분노가 우리를 향해 불타올랐기 때문이다.

pt.L: então vivos nos teriam engolido, quando a ira deles se acendeu contra nós,
pt.B: então nos teriam devorado vivos no calor da sua ira contra nós,
pt.R: Então eles teriam nos comido vivos, porque a raiva deles ardia contra nós.

am.L: ያን ጊዜ ቁጣቸው በእኛ ላይ በነደደ ጊዜ በሕይወት ሳለን በዋጡን ነበር፤
am.B: ያን ጊዜ በእኛ ላይ በነደደው ቁጣቸው በሕይወት ሳለን በዋጡን ነበር፤
am.R: ያን ጊዜ በሕይወት ሳለን በበሉን ነበር፤ ቁጣቸው በእኛ ላይ ነድዶ ነበርና።

hi.L: तब वे हमें जीवित निगल जाते, \q जब उनका क्रोध हम पर भड़का,
hi.B: तब वे अपने भड़के हुए क्रोध में हमें जीवित ही निगल जाते,
hi.R: तब वे हमें ज़िंदा ही खा जाते, \q क्योंकि उनका ग़ुस्सा हम पर भड़क उठा था।

ru.L: тогда живыми они поглотили бы нас, \q когда пылал гнев их на нас,
ru.B: тогда они проглотили бы нас живыми в пылу своего гнева на нас,
ru.R: Тогда они съели бы нас живьём, \q потому что их гнев пылал против нас.

ja.L: そのとき、彼らはわたしたちを生きたまま、のみ込んでいただろう、 \q 彼らの怒りがわたしたちに向かって燃え上がったとき。
ja.B: そのとき、彼らは、わたしたちに向かって燃える怒りのうちに、 \q わたしたちを生きたまま、のみ込んでいただろう。
ja.R: そうなっていたら、彼らはわたしたちを生きたまま食べてしまっただろう。 \q 彼らの怒りが、わたしたちに向かって燃えていたからだ。

uk.L: тоді вони живцем проковтнули б нас, \q коли запалав їхній гнів проти нас,
uk.B: тоді вони пожерли б нас живцем у запалі свого гніву проти нас,
uk.R: Тоді вони зʼїли б нас живцем, \q бо їхній гнів палав проти нас.

decisions.choice: swallowed alive: like the grave
decisions.reason: To be swallowed alive is what the grave does (Proverbs 1:12); the earth swallowed Korah and his followers alive (Numbers 16:30-33). The enemies are pictured as a monster or as death itself.

decisions.choice: then: what would have happened
decisions.reason: "Then" (azay) begins each of verses 3-5, saying what would have happened if the LORD had not been with Israel.

decisions.choice: their anger burned: they were furious
decisions.reason: Anger is often said to burn or flare up (2:12; 106:40).

decisions.choice: 'azai "そのとき" (L, B), "そうなっていたら" (R), with the past conditional 〜ていただろう in 124:3-5
decisions.reason: What would have happened (m2); the same frame in all three "then" verses.

records.literal_gloss: then the waters would have overflowed us, a torrent would have passed over our soul,

en.L: then the waters would have swept over us, a torrent would have passed over our soul,
en.B: then the floodwaters would have carried us off, a torrent would have rushed over us,
en.R: Then the flood would have washed us away. The rushing water would have covered us.

fr.L: alors les eaux nous auraient submergés, un torrent aurait passé sur notre âme,
fr.B: alors les eaux en crue nous auraient emportés, un torrent nous aurait recouverts,
fr.R: Alors l’inondation nous aurait emportés. L’eau rapide nous aurait recouverts.

sw.L: basi maji yangetugharikisha, mto wa mafuriko ungepita juu ya nafsi yetu,
sw.B: basi mafuriko yangetuchukua, mkondo wa maji ungetupita juu,
sw.R: Mafuriko yangetusomba. Maji yanayokimbia kwa nguvu yangetufunika.

es.L: entonces las aguas nos habrían arrastrado, un torrente habría pasado sobre nuestra alma;
es.B: entonces la inundación nos habría arrastrado, un torrente nos habría pasado por encima;
es.R: Entonces la inundación nos habría arrastrado. El agua que corría nos habría cubierto.

vi.L: thì các dòng nước đã cuốn chúng ta đi, dòng thác đã tràn qua linh hồn chúng ta,
vi.B: thì nước lũ đã cuốn chúng ta đi, dòng thác đã ào qua trên chúng ta,
vi.R: Thì cơn lũ đã cuốn trôi chúng ta. Dòng nước chảy xiết đã nhận chìm chúng ta.

ko.L: 그때에 물이 우리를 휩쓸었을 것이고, 급류가 우리 영혼 위로 지나갔을 것이다.
ko.B: 홍수가 우리를 쓸어 가고, 급류가 우리를 덮쳤을 것이며,
ko.R: 그랬다면 홍수가 우리를 쓸어 가 버렸을 것이다. 거센 물살이 우리를 덮었을 것이다.

pt.L: então as águas nos teriam arrastado, uma torrente teria passado sobre a nossa alma,
pt.B: então as águas da enchente nos teriam levado, uma torrente teria passado por cima de nós,
pt.R: Então a enchente teria nos levado embora. A água correndo forte teria nos coberto.

am.L: ያን ጊዜ ውኆቹ ባጥለቀለቁን ነበር፤ ፈሳሹም በነፍሳችን ላይ ባለፈ ነበር፤
am.B: ያን ጊዜ ጎርፉ ጠራርጎ በወሰደን ነበር፤ ፈሳሹም በላያችን ላይ በተመመ ነበር፤
am.R: ያን ጊዜ ጎርፉ ጠራርጎ በወሰደን ነበር። የሚጎርፈውም ውኃ በሸፈነን ነበር።

hi.L: तब जल हमें बहा ले जाता, \q एक धारा हमारे प्राण पर से होकर निकल जाती,
hi.B: तब बाढ़ का पानी हमें बहा ले जाता, \q उफनती धारा हम पर से होकर बह जाती,
hi.R: तब बाढ़ हमें बहा ले जाती। \q तेज़ बहता पानी हमें ढक लेता।

ru.L: тогда воды затопили бы нас, \q поток прошёл бы над душой нашей,
ru.B: тогда наводнение унесло бы нас, \q поток пронёсся бы над нами,
ru.R: Тогда потоп смыл бы нас. \q Бурная вода накрыла бы нас.

ja.L: そのとき、水はわたしたちを押し流し、 \q 激流がわたしたちの魂の上を越えて行っただろう。
ja.B: そのとき、大水はわたしたちを押し流し、 \q 激流がわたしたちの上を襲っただろう。
ja.R: そうなっていたら、洪水がわたしたちを押し流しただろう。 \q 激しい流れが、わたしたちを覆っただろう。

uk.L: тоді води залили б нас, \q потік пройшов би над нашою душею,
uk.B: тоді повінь понесла б нас, \q потік промчав би над нами,
uk.R: Тоді повінь змила б нас. \q Бурхлива вода накрила б нас.

decisions.choice: torrent: a flash flood in a dry valley
decisions.reason: The word (nachal) is a stream bed, often dry, that fills suddenly with a violent flood after rain. Floods are a common picture of overwhelming enemies (18:5, 17; 69:2-3).

decisions.choice: our soul: us, or our throat
alternatives: our necks (water up to the neck)
decisions.reason: Nefesh is the whole living person, but it can also mean the throat; the water rising over it is drowning (69:2; Jonah 2:6).

decisions.choice: our soul (L); us (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Psalms 1-12, nefesh is "soul" at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "me" or "my life", since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: над душой нашей (L); над нами (B); нас (R)
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, nefesh is душа at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "we" or "us" as the English level does, since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: nachlah "激流" (L, B), "激しい流れ" (R); nafshenu "わたしたちの魂" (L), dropped (B, R)
decisions.reason: A flash flood in a dry valley (m1); nefesh as the Psalter rule (m2 uncertain).

records.literal_gloss: then would have passed over our soul the waters, the raging [ones].

en.L: then over our soul would have passed the raging waters.
en.B: then the raging waters would have closed over us.
en.R: Those wild waters would have drowned us.

fr.L: alors sur notre âme auraient passé les eaux impétueuses.
fr.B: alors les eaux déchaînées se seraient refermées sur nous.
fr.R: Ces eaux sauvages nous auraient noyés.

sw.L: basi yangepita juu ya nafsi yetu maji yanayochafuka.

es.L: entonces sobre nuestra alma habrían pasado las aguas embravecidas.
es.B: entonces las aguas embravecidas se habrían cerrado sobre nosotros.
es.R: Aquellas aguas salvajes nos habrían ahogado.

vi.L: thì các dòng nước cuồn cuộn đã tràn qua linh hồn chúng ta.
vi.B: thì những dòng nước cuồn cuộn đã phủ lấp chúng ta.
vi.R: Những dòng nước dữ dội ấy đã làm chúng ta chết đuối rồi.

ko.L: 그때에 우리 영혼 위로 사납게 날뛰는 물이 지나갔을 것이다.
ko.B: 사나운 물결이 우리를 덮어 버렸을 것이다.
ko.R: 그 거친 물이 우리를 삼켜 버렸을 것이다.

pt.L: então teriam passado sobre a nossa alma as águas impetuosas.
pt.B: então as águas furiosas teriam se fechado sobre nós.
pt.R: Aquelas águas violentas teriam nos afogado.

am.L: ያን ጊዜ የሚያስገመግሙት ውኆች በነፍሳችን ላይ ባለፉ ነበር።
am.B: ያን ጊዜ የሚናወጡት ውኆች በላያችን ላይ በተዘጉ ነበር።

hi.L: तब हमारे प्राण पर से उफनते \q जल निकल जाते।
hi.B: तब उफनता जल हमारे ऊपर छा जाता।
hi.R: वह उग्र पानी हमें डुबो देता।

ru.L: тогда прошли бы над душой нашей \q воды бушующие.
ru.B: тогда бушующие воды \q сомкнулись бы над нами.
ru.R: Эти дикие воды утопили бы нас.

ja.L: そのとき、わたしたちの魂の上を越えて行っただろう、 \q 荒れ狂う水が。
ja.B: そのとき、荒れ狂う水が、わたしたちの上に覆いかぶさっただろう。
ja.R: あの荒れ狂う水に、わたしたちはおぼれていただろう。

uk.L: тоді над нашою душею пройшли б води, \q шалені.
uk.B: тоді шалені води зімкнулися б над нами.
uk.R: Ці дикі води потопили б нас.

decisions.choice: raging: proud, insolent
decisions.reason: The word (zedonim) comes from a root meaning to boil up and to act with arrogance. The waters are pictured like the proud enemies they stand for.

decisions.choice: our soul (L); us (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Psalms 1-12, nefesh is "soul" at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "me" or "my life", since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: drowned us
decisions.reason: Readable says what the waters going over the throat means (124:4 m2).

decisions.choice: над душой нашей (L); над нами (B); нас (R)
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, nefesh is душа at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "we" or "us" as the English level does, since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: hazzedonim "荒れ狂う" (every level)
decisions.reason: The word is "proud, insolent" (m1), said of the water; 荒れ狂う keeps both the wildness and the arrogance.

source.text: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה שֶׁלֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be] YHWH, who not has given us [as] prey to their teeth.

en.L: Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has not given us [as] prey to their teeth.
en.B: Blessed be {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! He did not give us up to be torn apart by their teeth.
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! He did not let our enemies tear us to pieces like wild animals.

fr.L: Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui ne nous a pas donnés [en] proie à leurs dents !
fr.B: Béni soit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Il ne nous a pas livrés pour être déchirés par leurs dents.
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Il n’a pas laissé nos ennemis nous mettre en pièces comme des bêtes sauvages.

sw.L: Na abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambaye hakututoa [kuwa] mawindo kwa meno yao.
sw.B: Abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Hakututoa tuchanwe kwa meno yao.
sw.R: Asifiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Hakuwaacha adui zetu watupasue vipande vipande kama wanyama wa porini.

es.L: Bendito [sea] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que no nos ha dado [como] presa a sus dientes.
es.B: ¡Bendito sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Él no nos entregó para que sus dientes nos despedazaran.
es.R: ¡Alabado sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Él no dejó que nuestros enemigos nos hicieran pedazos como animales salvajes.

vi.L: Chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã không phó chúng ta [làm] mồi cho răng chúng.
vi.B: Chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Ngài đã không để chúng ta bị răng chúng xé nát.
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Ngài đã không để kẻ thù xé xác chúng ta như thú dữ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 송축을 받으시기를. 그분께서 우리를 그들의 이에 먹이로 내주지 않으셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라! 그분께서 우리를 그들의 이빨에 찢기도록 내주지 않으셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라! 그분께서는 원수들이 들짐승처럼 우리를 갈기갈기 찢도록 내버려 두지 않으셨다.

pt.L: Bendito [seja] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que não nos entregou [como] presa aos dentes deles.
pt.B: Bendito seja {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! Ele não nos entregou para sermos despedaçados pelos dentes deles.
pt.R: Louvado seja {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}! Ele não deixou que os nossos inimigos nos despedaçassem como animais selvagens.

am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይመስገን! ጠላቶቻችን እንደ አውሬ እንዲበጣጥሱን አልፈቀደም።

hi.L: धन्य [हों] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, \q जिन्होंने हमें उनके दाँतों का शिकार [होने] नहीं दिया।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} धन्य हों! \q उन्होंने हमें उनके दाँतों से फाड़े जाने के लिए नहीं सौंपा।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करो! \q उन्होंने हमारे शत्रुओं को जंगली पशुओं की तरह हमें चीर-फाड़ करने नहीं दिया।

ru.L: Благословен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, \q который не отдал нас [в] добычу зубам их.
ru.B: Благословен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}! \q Он не отдал нас на растерзание их зубам.
ru.R: Слава {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}! \q Он не дал нашим врагам растерзать нас, как дикие звери.

ja.L: ほめたたえられよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、 \q わたしたちを彼らの歯のえじきとしてお与えにならなかった方は。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がほめたたえられるように。 \q その方は、わたしたちが彼らの歯に引き裂かれるままにはなさらなかった。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をほめたたえよう！ \q その方は、敵が野の獣のようにわたしたちをかみ裂くのを、お許しにならなかった。

uk.L: Благословенний {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, \q що не віддав нас [як] здобич їхнім зубам.
uk.B: Благословенний {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}! \q Він не віддав нас на розтерзання їхнім зубам.
uk.R: Хваліть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}! \q Він не дав нашим ворогам розірвати нас на шматки, як дикі звірі.

decisions.choice: blessed: praised
decisions.reason: To bless (barak) the LORD is to praise him with thanks for what he has done.

decisions.choice: prey to their teeth: torn like a hunted animal
decisions.reason: The enemies are now pictured as wild beasts tearing their prey (7:3; 57:5).

decisions.choice: our enemies ... like wild animals
decisions.reason: Readable names the enemies and says what the picture is (m2).

decisions.choice: "abarikiwe" (may he be blessed) at Literal and Balanced; "Asifiwe" (may he be praised) at Readable
decisions.reason: People bless God by speaking well of him with thanks. Literal and Balanced keep the word "bless" (kubariki), as the terms for these psalms do; Readable says "praise", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Chúc tụng" (L, B) for "blessed be"; "Hãy ca ngợi" (R)
decisions.reason: To bless God is to praise him (see the meaning decision). "chúc tụng" is the word the terms note keeps for blessing God; Readable says "ca ngợi" (praise), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "송축을 받으시기를" (L), "송축하여라" (B), "찬양하여라" (R) for "Blessed be the LORD"
decisions.reason: "송축하다" is the terms note's word for blessing God; Literal keeps the Hebrew's wish form, Balanced turns it to a call to bless, and Readable says "praise" as the English Readable does. The older ending "-리로다" is avoided (style guide section 1).

decisions.choice: "blessed be the LORD" as "ይባረክ" (Literal, Balanced), "ይመስገን" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms list's pattern for blessing God; Readable says "praise", as the English Readable does.
Blessing the LORD is praising him (meaning m1). Literal and Balanced keep "धन्य", as the poetry note has it, with the honorific plural for God; Readable says "praise", as the English does.

decisions.choice: Слава ГОСПОДУ!
decisions.reason: Readable says "Praise the LORD" for blessing God (m1). Russian Readable uses the exclamation Слава ГОСПОДУ here, keeping Хвалите for the call to people to praise and for Hallelujah.

decisions.choice: barukh YHWH "ほめたたえられよ" (L), "ほめたたえられるように" (B), "ほめたたえよう" (R); the negative for God "お与えにならなかった" (L), "…ままにはなさらなかった" (B), "お許しにならなかった" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter forms for barukh and for God's negatives (never 〜られなかった).

source.text: נַפְשֵׁ֗נוּ כְּצִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִפַּ֪ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַפַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Our soul like a bird has escaped from [the] snare of fowlers; the snare is broken, and we have escaped.

en.L: Our soul has escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowlers; the snare is broken, and we have escaped.
en.B: We have slipped free like a bird from the bird-catchers' trap; the trap is broken, and we are free!
en.R: We got away like a bird that escapes from a hunter's trap. The trap broke, and we got away!

fr.L: Notre âme s’est échappée comme un oiseau du piège des oiseleurs ; le piège s’est brisé, et nous nous sommes échappés.
fr.B: Nous nous sommes échappés comme un oiseau du filet des chasseurs ; le filet s’est rompu, et nous voilà libres !
fr.R: Nous nous sommes sauvés comme un oiseau qui s’échappe du piège d’un chasseur. Le piège s’est cassé, et nous nous sommes sauvés !

sw.L: Nafsi yetu imeponyoka kama ndege kutoka mtego wa wategaji; mtego umevunjika, nasi tumeponyoka.
sw.B: Tumejinasua kama ndege kutoka kwenye mtego wa wanaonasa ndege; mtego umevunjika, nasi tuko huru!
sw.R: Tuliponyoka kama ndege anayetoroka mtego wa mwindaji. Mtego ulivunjika, nasi tukaponyoka!

es.L: Nuestra alma ha escapado como un pájaro de la trampa de los cazadores; la trampa se ha roto, y nosotros hemos escapado.
es.B: Nos hemos soltado como un pájaro de la trampa de los cazadores de aves; ¡la trampa se rompió, y estamos libres!
es.R: Escapamos como un pájaro que se escapa de la trampa de un cazador. ¡La trampa se rompió, y escapamos!

vi.L: Linh hồn chúng ta đã thoát như con chim khỏi bẫy của người bẫy chim; bẫy đã gãy, và chúng ta đã thoát.
vi.B: Chúng ta đã vụt thoát như con chim khỏi bẫy của người bắt chim; bẫy đã gãy, và chúng ta được tự do!
vi.R: Chúng ta đã thoát ra như con chim thoát khỏi bẫy của người thợ săn. Cái bẫy gãy rồi, và chúng ta đã thoát!

ko.L: 우리 영혼이 새처럼 새 잡는 자들의 덫에서 벗어났다. 덫이 끊어지고, 우리가 벗어났다.
ko.B: 우리는 새 잡는 사람의 덫에서 빠져나온 새처럼 풀려났다. 덫이 부서지고 우리는 자유로워졌다!
ko.R: 우리는 사냥꾼의 덫에서 빠져나온 새처럼 도망쳤다. 덫이 망가져서 우리가 빠져나왔다!

pt.L: A nossa alma, como um pássaro, escapou do laço dos caçadores de pássaros; o laço se quebrou, e nós escapamos.
pt.B: Escapamos como um pássaro da armadilha dos passarinheiros; a armadilha se partiu, e estamos livres!
pt.R: Nós fugimos como um pássaro que escapa da armadilha de um caçador. A armadilha quebrou, e nós escapamos!

am.L: ነፍሳችን ከአዳኞች ወጥመድ እንደ ወፍ አመለጠች፤ ወጥመዱ ተሰበረ፤ እኛም አመለጥን።
am.B: ከወፍ አጥማጆች ወጥመድ እንደ ወፍ አምልጠናል፤ ወጥመዱ ተሰበረ፤ እኛም ነጻ ወጣን!
am.R: ከአዳኝ ወጥመድ እንደሚያመልጥ ወፍ አመለጥን። ወጥመዱ ተሰበረ፤ እኛም አመለጥን!

hi.L: हमारा प्राण चिड़िया की तरह बहेलियों के फंदे से बच निकला है; \q फंदा टूट गया, और हम बच निकले हैं।
hi.B: हम चिड़िया की तरह बहेलियों के जाल से छूट निकले हैं; \q जाल टूट गया, और हम आज़ाद हैं!
hi.R: हम उस चिड़िया की तरह बच निकले जो शिकारी के जाल से छूट जाती है। \q जाल टूट गया, और हम बच निकले!

ru.L: Душа наша избавилась, как птица, из силка птицеловов; \q силок разорван, и мы избавились.
ru.B: Мы вырвались на свободу, как птица из ловушки птицеловов; \q ловушка сломана, и мы свободны!
ru.R: Мы спаслись, как птица, которая вырывается из ловушки охотника. \q Ловушка сломалась, и мы спаслись!

ja.L: わたしたちの魂は、鳥のように、鳥を捕る者たちのわなから逃れた。 \q わなは破られ、わたしたちは逃れた。
ja.B: わたしたちは、鳥のように、鳥を捕る者たちのわなから抜け出した。 \q わなは破られ、わたしたちは自由になった！
ja.R: わたしたちは、鳥を捕る人のわなから逃げる鳥のように、逃げ出した。 \q わなが壊れて、わたしたちは助かった！

uk.L: Наша душа, як птах, утекла з сітки птахоловів; \q сітка порвалася, і ми втекли.
uk.B: Ми вирвалися, як птах із пастки птахоловів; \q пастка зламалася, і ми вільні!
uk.R: Ми втекли, як пташка, що вирвалася з пастки мисливця. \q Пастка зламалася, і ми втекли!

decisions.choice: the snare of fowlers: a bird trap
decisions.reason: Bird-catchers used nets and spring traps (Amos 3:5; Proverbs 7:23). A bird caught in one could not free itself.

decisions.choice: is broken: broken by someone else
decisions.reason: The verb is passive and does not name who broke the trap; the bird could not, and verses 6 and 8 give the credit to the LORD.

decisions.choice: our soul (L); we (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Psalms 1-12, nefesh is "soul" at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "me" or "my life", since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: душа наша (L); мы (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, nefesh is душа at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "we" or "us" as the English level does, since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: nishbar "破られ" (L, B), "壊れて" (R)
decisions.reason: The trap was broken by someone else (m2), so L and B keep the passive.

source.text: עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Our help [is] in [the] name of YHWH, maker of heaven and earth.

en.L: Our help [is] in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, maker of heaven and earth.
en.B: We find our help in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the one who made heaven and earth.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, who made heaven and earth, is the one who helps us.

fr.L: Notre secours [est] dans le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui a fait le ciel et la terre.
fr.B: Notre secours, nous le trouvons dans le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, celui qui a fait le ciel et la terre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui a fait le ciel et la terre, est celui qui nous aide.

sw.L: Msaada wetu [uko] katika jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, muumba wa mbingu na nchi.
sw.B: Tunapata msaada wetu katika jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyeumba mbingu na nchi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyeumba mbingu na dunia, ndiye anayetusaidia.

es.L: Nuestra ayuda [está] en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, hacedor de los cielos y de la tierra.
es.B: Encontramos nuestra ayuda en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el que hizo los cielos y la tierra.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hizo los cielos y la tierra, es quien nos ayuda.

vi.L: Sự giúp đỡ của chúng ta [ở] trong danh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng làm nên trời và đất.
vi.B: Chúng ta tìm được sự giúp đỡ trong danh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã tạo nên trời và đất.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã dựng nên trời và đất, là Đấng giúp đỡ chúng ta.

ko.L: 우리의 도움은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름에 있으니, 하늘과 땅을 지으신 분이시다.
ko.B: 우리의 도움은 하늘과 땅을 만드신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름에 있다.
ko.R: 하늘과 땅을 만드신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리를 도와주시는 분이다.

pt.L: A nossa ajuda [está] no nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o que fez os céus e a terra.
pt.B: Encontramos a nossa ajuda no nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, aquele que fez o céu e a terra.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, que fez o céu e a terra, é quem nos ajuda.

am.B: ረድኤታችንን የምናገኘው ሰማያትንና ምድርን በሠራው {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም ነው።

hi.L: हमारी सहायता {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम में [है], \q जो आकाश और पृथ्वी के बनानेवाले [हैं]।
hi.B: हमारी सहायता {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम में मिलती है, \q जिन्होंने आकाश और पृथ्वी को बनाया।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जिन्होंने आकाश और धरती को बनाया, \q वही हमारी मदद करते हैं।

ru.L: Помощь наша — в имени {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q Творца неба и земли.
ru.B: Наша помощь — в имени {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q который сотворил небо и землю.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, который сотворил небо \q и землю, — тот, кто помогает нам.

ja.L: わたしたちの助けは、 \q 天と地を造られた方、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名にある。
ja.B: わたしたちの助けは、天と地を造られた方、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の名のうちにある。
ja.R: 天と地を造られた{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ、 \q わたしたちを助けてくださる方だ。

uk.L: Наша допомога — в імені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q творця неба й землі.
uk.B: Ми знаходимо допомогу в імені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q того, хто створив небо й землю.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, який створив небо \q й землю, — той, хто допомагає нам.

decisions.choice: the name of the LORD: the LORD himself
decisions.reason: As in 122:4, the name stands for the LORD as he has made himself known, the one his people call on (20:2, 8).

decisions.choice: maker of heaven and earth: the creator of all
decisions.reason: As in 121:2, a title naming the LORD as the creator of everything; it also closes 134:3.

decisions.choice: the LORD ... is the one who helps us
alternatives: in the name of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "the name" (m1).

decisions.choice: the wording of 121:2
decisions.reason: "Maker of heaven and earth" keeps the Hindi of 121:2 at each level, as the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: "天と地を造られた方、DNの名" with the title before the name
decisions.reason: Japanese puts the description before the noun; the wording of 'oseh shamayim va'arets is the same as 121:2 and 134:3.
